context: M2 o2. A man in a plaid sport coat comes through the door with a box of doughnuts.

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: Folks! Vic Prentiss. New management. I brought crullers. Who's the desk man?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I am. Desk opens at eleven.

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: Teddy, right? Can I call you Teddy? Manny told me all about you.

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: Big changes coming. Good changes. Anybody wants to move, we help. Cash help.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Nobody here wants to move, Mr. Prentiss.

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: Odessa! Can I call you Odessa? Everybody wants something. Here's my card.

choices.text: Tell him where to put it.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I'll keep it by the phone. In case of fire.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Put it with the crullers, Mr. Prentiss. Somewhere you can find it.

lines.speaker: char.vic_prentiss
lines.text: Ha! I like him. I like you, Teddy. We're gonna be friends.
